Method of Attack: Performance degradation caused by content script code in the extension engine leading to severe slowdowns on YouTube and other dynamically updating sites
Extension engine version 1.1.1 introduced in Adblock 5.17 and Adblock Plus 3.22 caused high CPU usage and slow video buffering
Impacted Systems: YouTube on Chrome and Edge browsers
Operating systems running Chrome with Adblock or Adblock Plus installed
Attack Vector: Browser extension content script causing performance issues on websites
Indicators of Compromise: Slow video buffering and loading times on YouTube with Adblock or Adblock Plus enabled
High CPU usage reported during YouTube playback
Performance issues resolved after updating to Adblock 5.17.1 and Adblock Plus 3.22.1
